title: Foundryside
author: Robert Jackson Bennett
summary: Sancia is a thief in a city where objects can be written with commands that convince them reality works differently. When she steals a strange artefact from a merchant house, she is hunted, and her theft threatens the city's balance.
readIf: you like fast, inventive fantasy with a thief heroine and a magic system that feels almost like engineering.
skipIf: you want a quiet, slow-building fantasy or dislike stories with heavy action.

pairings.reason: Another clever con-and-theft story set in a vivid city run by wealthy interests.
A crew of skilled misfits pulling off an impossible job in a rich fantasy city.
A heist, a rebellion and a carefully designed magic system, on an epic scale.
